correct: A conditional-cell average multiplied by a scalar count is not the adaptive likelihood when assignments vary with context. Pointwise Gaussian information integrated against arm-specific occupation measures is exact.
Synchronize the frontier question with the corrected implicit width and remove any dependence on the obsolete scalar allocation program.

narrow: The frontier question must refer to the corrected budget-dependent occupation width and must not inherit the obsolete sign-switch cells, scalar quotas, or any assumed saturation or realization property.

narrow: The original question was indexed by cell alone, omitted context-arrival and welfare constraints, and asked about the obsolete \(w_n\). The corrected question is narrowed to saturation, duality, and common sequential realization for the baseline-indexed occupation program.
Activity is a property of a baseline law and a cell, not of a cell alone.
The handle must not advertise an estimator or design that has not been constructed.

verdict.note: Accept all 35 items. The PR faithfully replaces the invalid scalar-cell program by a baseline-indexed occupation-measure relaxation: complete target-separating alternatives, exact pointwise Gaussian information, correct sup_P inf_nu necessary orientation, valid context-capacity and welfare constraints, and a correctly signed Lagrange lower value with proved weak duality only. The design-embedding converse establishes W >= w_{T,rho} without asserting common-design realization. Saturation, strong duality, attainment, and joint sequential realization remain explicitly open in the two OEQs.
